projects.label: Creator of
projects.name: Rootly-Runtime
projects.tagline: Surface production errors directly in your IDE.
projects.description: Rootly is a developer platform that brings production errors into your IDE with full context, enabling faster debugging without switching tools.
projects.longDescription:
Rootly is a developer-focused error monitoring platform designed to eliminate context switching between production systems and development environments. Instead of relying on external dashboards, Rootly surfaces production errors directly inside your IDE with complete debugging context.

Applications integrate a lightweight Node.js SDK that captures runtime errors, including stack traces, environment details, timestamps, and commit SHA. These events are sent to a backend API where they are validated, stored, and made available for querying.

The platform includes a VS Code extension that polls the backend at regular intervals to fetch new incidents. Developers receive notifications directly inside their editor and can instantly navigate to the exact file and line where the error occurred using parsed stack traces.

The system is built with a full-stack architecture using Node.js, Express, and PostgreSQL, with GitHub OAuth for authentication and project-based API key management for secure ingestion.
highlights: IDE integration via VS Code extension with in-editor error visibility
Direct navigation to error location using parsed stack traces
Lightweight Node.js SDK for runtime error capture
Structured error ingestion with strict validation (stack trace, commit SHA, environment)
Polling-based incident fetching with in-IDE notifications
PostgreSQL-backed incident storage with relational schema
GitHub OAuth authentication with secure session management
Project-scoped API keys for secure ingestion

projects.label: Creator of
projects.name: Vyzora
projects.description: Vyzora is a high-performance, privacy-first analytics platform for real-time event tracking, session reconstruction, and aggregated insights — without relying on third-party trackers.
projects.longDescription:
Vyzora is a privacy-first analytics platform engineered to provide developers with deep product insights while maintaining full control over user data. Unlike traditional analytics tools that rely on third-party tracking and invasive techniques, Vyzora is fully self-hosted and avoids external data sharing.

Developers integrate a lightweight TypeScript SDK (< 3KB gzipped) that automatically tracks pageviews, supports SPA navigation, batches events efficiently, and ensures reliable delivery using sendBeacon and fetch fallbacks. The SDK maintains anonymous visitor and session identifiers using localStorage with safe fallbacks, without collecting personally identifiable information.

The backend is built as a horizontally scalable, asynchronous ingestion system. Incoming events are received by API replicas, queued via Redis using BullMQ, and processed by worker services that perform bulk inserts into PostgreSQL. This decoupled architecture ensures consistent low-latency ingestion even under high traffic spikes.

The developer dashboard, built with Next.js, provides real-time aggregated metrics such as pageviews, sessions, top pages, and trends. Authentication is handled securely using GitHub OAuth, and all data remains fully controlled by the developer.
highlights: 100% self-hosted — no third-party tracking or data sharing
Lightweight SDK (< 3KB gzipped) with automatic pageview and SPA tracking
Asynchronous ingestion using Redis + BullMQ for high scalability
Bulk event processing with PostgreSQL and optimized indexing
Horizontally scalable architecture with API and worker replicas
Real-time aggregated metrics (pageviews, sessions, trends, top pages)
GitHub OAuth authentication with secure JWT-based sessions
Project-scoped API keys for secure event ingestion

projects.label: Creator of
projects.name: Learning's Hub
projects.tagline: Master DSA and development skills with structured progress tracking.
projects.description: Learning's Hub is a full-stack platform for tracking DSA, programming, and exam preparation with structured lists, progress sync, and community-driven learning.
projects.longDescription:
Learning's Hub is a full-stack learning management platform designed to solve fragmented developer learning workflows. Instead of jumping between multiple platforms with no unified tracking, it provides a structured system to manage learning progress across DSA, programming languages, and competitive exams.

Users can create custom learning lists with sections, topics, and resources such as videos and practice problems. Each item can be tracked individually, with progress stored and synchronized across devices using a database-backed system. Built-in checklists for DSA and examination preparation are optimized using batch APIs to reduce network overhead and ensure efficient updates.

The platform also supports community-driven learning through public lists. Users can explore, rate, copy, and trace the lineage of shared lists, enabling collaborative knowledge building. Authentication is handled via JWT with email verification, password recovery, and secure session management.

The system is optimized for performance using batch operations, rate limiting, and debounced syncing, reducing API calls significantly while maintaining real-time responsiveness in the UI.
highlights: Structured learning lists with sections, topics, and resources
Per-item progress tracking with multi-device synchronization
Built-in DSA and examination tracking system
Batch API system reducing network requests by ~94%
Public list sharing, rating, and copying with lineage tracking
JWT-based authentication with email verification and password reset
Rate-limited APIs for secure and fair usage
Optimized UI with responsive terminal-style design
